sources.title: USPS Domestic Claims - The Basics
claims: For USPS domestic damage claims, retain the damaged item and package while the claim is pending; photographs can show damage; proof of value and insurance may be needed; timing depends on service.
Carrier claim instructions and coverage depend on the actual service and shipment; do not generalize USPS terms to other carriers.

sources.title: UPS File a Claim
claims: UPS tells claimants to keep the damaged package contents, packaging and value evidence.

sources.title: FedEx File a Claim
claims: FedEx tells claimants to keep original packaging and contents until a damage claim is resolved.

status: USPS, UPS and FedEx primary claim instructions reviewed; article directs readers to verify their actual service and bullion classification.
